title: Pip and the Trail
note: b416 — Phase 4 complete (Learning) — new consonant clusters nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow noticing a small crumb lying on the garden path.
Pip the sparrow spotting a second small crumb a little further along.
Pip the sparrow hopping along, picking up crumbs one after another.
Pip the sparrow looking along a trail of small crumbs stretching into the distance.
Pip the sparrow following the trail of crumbs further along the path.
The trail of crumbs leading right up to a small wooden box.
Pip the sparrow hopping up onto the lid of the wooden box.
Nell the bee sitting on top of the box, an empty crumb bag beside her.
Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee grinning together on top of the box.
